description: Summarize and analyze a web page: the URL is rendered in a real browser, its content extracted, and a written brief answering your question returned, grounded in that page only and saying so when the page does not answer. Use it for competitor pages, docs, articles and listings. Input: url; optional question. Fixed JSON fields: research.page_facts. Needs a web search: research.web. $5.00 per call. Returns: brief, title, final_url, source{}, model.

language.description: Optional answer language, BCP-47 (en, ja, pt-BR). Default: the input's.

name: hubvibe_research_brief
title: Research brief on a URL
